If the mint path cannot do this without a larger change, the run parks with the evidence instead of choosing a design.\u0022,\u0022Event streams written before AnswerOnly existed still finalize as full reviews and still open follow-through.\u0022,\u0022Each of the four criteria above has a unit test that touches no database, branch, git, or GitHub.\u0022,\u0022The operations.md guidance for h9k review resolve --merge-ready on an answer-only task says the task ends there and nothing watches the pull request afterwards.\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Routed from the adversarial review of 447cd320 (#681). Verified on main 2026-10-03 by the orchestrator window: FinalizeAsync appends TaskDecider.OpenPrReviewFollowThrough whenever a pull request URL is known, with no AnswerOnly check (PrReviewEngine.cs:1449); AnswerOnly lives on the task aggregate (TaskAggregate.cs) and is honoured only on the minting event. Follow-through then sees HeadMoved (PrReviewAuthorActivity.Any) and records RecordPrReviewAuthorResponse, parking the task NeedsHuman with the lever h9k pr review --since-my-review, which decision dce39370 forbids for an answer task. Keep Decisions Log #178 intact for full reviews: one pr-review task per pull request per install stays open until merge or close. The original finding, verbatim, is below the line in the previous revision of this card\\u0027s context.
